body: LEAD DISPOSITION ON THE FINAL D2/D4 ADVERSARIAL PASS: ACCEPT, NO ARCHITECTURE BLOCKER, DO NOT REOPEN THE EXACT-HASH PLAN. The reviewer re-read the current 669-line artifact and withdrew its P1 objection: it had misread open as unblocked; the plan consistently says P1 is outstanding and blocks movie implementation. It also confirmed that the plan already contains the required PTS/DTS separation, exact rational timebase and edition/rendition identity, checked edit-list composition, VFR lookup, distinct clock-repair/track-composition/edition-correspondence, occurrence identity, total projection outcomes, nonfunctional reverse mapping, four non-convertible identity domains, interval-local proposal relations, orthogonal visibility/emission/vocalization/diegesis/rendition, sensitive sidecars, and the relevant mutation courts. Two useful explicit negative-claim rules are accepted as future C1/G2 construction criteria: (1) presentation gap is not decoded silence, processing failure, or unexamined extent; (2) Offscreen is a substantive visibility proposal, never inferred from no face candidate, NotRequested, Failed, or ExaminedNoCandidate. Concrete Scala constructors, compile-time refusals, rational overflow/canonicalization, codec laws, scoped-ID equality refusals, and the combined VFR/edit-list/dub/listener/telephone/song factorial fixture belong in executable C1/G2 acceptance specs. They do not justify plan drift during durability review.
